jyutping: A jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 N

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that a place is full of something or that something abounds there.

examples.english: Food stalls teem inside the market.
examples.traditional: 個市集入面有好多小食檔。
examples.jyutping: go3 si5 zaap6 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 siu2 sik6 dong3
